caption: The drawing depicts a single armchair positioned at an angle so that both the front and part of the side are visible. The chair features a wooden frame with decorative carving details accentuated by dark brown tones. The backrest, seat, and arm rests of the chair are upholstered in a medium blue fabric with a lighter blue trim along the edges. The arm rests are topped with matching blue fabric pads. The seat is oval and slightly rounded in front, while the backrest is shaped with a central curve and angular corners. The four legs of the chair are finely tapered, fluted, and extend vertically down with follow-through woodcarving details. The background is an off-white or light beige color with some minor, uneven patches of darker beige or brown stains around the chair, but there are no other objects present. The artist’s signature “Byrenback” appears in the lower left corner.
title: Armchair
